exam_scheme.note: Under the Bihar Staff Selection Commission Examination Conduct Rules, 2010, the selection process comprises a Preliminary Examination (OMR objective format, with an open-book rule allowing up to 3 textbooks) and a Main Examination (Paper 1 General Hindi qualifying, and Paper 2 General Studies/Maths/Reasoning for merit). Shortlisting for Mains is strictly 5 times the vacancies.

stages.source_label: BSSC 4th CGL Advertisement No. 05/25 Notification Scheme & Syllabus

papers.paper_name: General Studies, General Science, Mathematics & Mental Ability (Open Book)
papers.negative_marking: 1 mark deducted per wrong answer; 4 marks awarded per correct answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Top candidates shortlisted in 1:5 ratio of vacancies; min qualifying: UR 40%, BC 36.5%, EBC 34%, SC/ST/Women 32%

stages.source_label: BSSC 4th CGL Advertisement No. 05/25 Notification Scheme & Syllabus

papers.negative_marking: 1 mark deducted per wrong answer; 4 marks awarded per correct answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Mandatory 30% marks; Paper 2 evaluated only if candidate scores at least 30% in Paper 1

papers.paper_name: Paper 2: General Knowledge, General Science, Mathematics & Reasoning
papers.negative_marking: 1 mark deducted per wrong answer; 4 marks awarded per correct answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Final merit list is prepared strictly based on aggregate marks obtained in Paper 2

financial_package.note: Pay scale shown for premier Secretariat Assistant / Assistant Section Officer and Planning Assistant posts in Level 7 (Basic ₹44,900). Subordinate cadres recruited through CGL span Level 6 (DEO Grade C: ₹35,400) and Level 5 (Auditor: ₹29,200).
financial_package.pay_source_label: BSSC 4th Graduate Level Combined Competitive Exam Advertisement No. 05/25
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 7 entry basic pay of ₹44,900 with 58% Dearness Allowance (₹26,042), House Rent Allowance (16% to 18% in Patna: ₹7,184 to ₹8,082; 8% in other districts), Medical Allowance (₹1,000), and Transport Allowance. In-hand reflects statutory 10% NPS deduction on Basic+DA (₹7,094), professional tax, and income tax.
official_perks: Government accommodation in Patna or House Rent Allowance (HRA) up to 18%
Medical reimbursement under Bihar State Government Health Rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment benefits
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% state government matching contribution
Office internet, computer equipment, and stationery allowance
